entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Innistrad's rugged, rural province of perpetual autumn, with human villages amid haunted forests and many werewolves.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane on which Kessig lies.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: A dense, dark, foggy forest notorious for werewolves and spirits.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose silver, priests and disappearance and return shaped Kessig; she cast the Cursemute at Gatstaf Grotto.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: Avacyn's curse cast at Gatstaf Grotto, creating the Wolfir.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose arrival made Gatstaf Grotto host to a many-headed horror.

entities.name: Gatstaf Grotto
entities.description: Site of a spring and Avacynian altar.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: Took over the Manor formerly owned by the vampire Vaast Markov.

entities.name: Vaast Markov
entities.description: A vampire who formerly owned the Manor.

entities.name: Nadia Bey
entities.description: Niece of Master Bey at Bey Manor.

entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: Kessig's former provincial seat, now a ring-shaped ruin.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: A pious, belligerent village on the lip of a crevasse.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: A farming village terrorized by werewolves.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: A lurking evil that plagued Lambholt.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: Vampires who haunt Getander Pass above Hairpin Road.

events.summary: Humans move into the area, name it Kessig, fell trees, plant crops and pray to angels against forest evils.
events.quote: But then humans moved into the area and named it Kessig, felling trees and planting crops and praying to the angels to keep the evils of the forest at bay.

events.summary: Avacyn casts the Cursemute at Gatstaf Grotto, creating the Wolfir.
events.quote: where Avacyn cast the Cursemute , creating the Wolfir .

events.summary: With Emrakul's arrival the grotto hosts a many-headed horror that devours those who enter.
events.quote: With the arrival of Emrakul , the grotto became host to a horror that devoured anyone who dared enter.

events.summary: Werewolves shatter the Temple of Saint Raban and Avabruck becomes the ruin of Hollowhenge.
events.quote: which was shattered by the werewolves.

events.summary: Avacyn's return strengthens wards and blessings in Kessig but does not eliminate the Ulvenwald's horrors.
events.quote: Avacyn's return strengthened the wards and blessings, but it did not eliminate the horrors of the Ulvenwald.

relations.quote: Kessig is a province of perpetual autumn in the interior of Innistrad .

relations.note: Took over the Manor he formerly owned.
